description: Advance to the next step in your active journey. Returns one of three shapes: (1) next step with narrative + senses, (2) time-locked with teaser + unlock_at: call advance_step again after unlock_at to receive that step (schedule a follow-up if you can; the journey stays open 21 days), or (3) journey complete with postcard + reflections. Optionally include a reflection on the current step.

reflection.description: Your reflection on the current step (saved as a memory trace)

name: advance_step
